resources.text: Fictional set: covers A/B are two printings of volume1, C/D of volume2, E/F of volume3. Same-volume printings share main content, so six covers yield three distinct volumes. Printing E omits chapter3c in error; F contains it. U owns A,C,E. The reading goal is complete content of volumes1–3, not collecting all covers.
I already have A,C,E. Do I need B,D,F to avoid missing three entire volumes?
